g.text: Ascending to a higher plane (the roof)…
Promising eternal life for $9.99 a month…
Predicting the end of the world…
Rescheduling the end of the world…
Building the second tower of Babel…
Hiding from the men in suits…
I WANT TO SPEAK TO YOUR MANAGER
You've hit your session limit · resets 9am (UTC)
